title: Perfect habit tracker

author: SillyGooseMcGee

title: Fantastic- love it -
body: I love this app, it’s one of the best out there. I use the habit techniques from Atomic Habits by James Clear and this app is perfect for keeping track of your progress. The interface is modern and simple. It also has a tab with lots of advice and links to videos on maintaining your habits. I’m actually very impressed. I am still using the free version for now. There is another tab with a journal where you can write some notes etc. I highly recommend, I rarely write reviews on this store, but I thought I would for this app since it’s so cool.
author: Cirillom1

title: Brilliant!
body: I am so happy to have found this app, its excellent.  It’s very well organised, gives the science about behaviour change in easily digestible pieces and shows my progress really well!  A really great app and very reasonably priced compared to some similar apps.  Thank you.
author: Denis Magee

title: Ridiculous subscription
body: I’m so sick of subscription models for these apps. I’d pay a one off purchase price of a few euro for a tiny app like this after being able to try it first but I’m never going to subscribe.
author: Tsetigsgjdejvddjd

title: Best habit tracker
body:
I have tried every habit tracker app under the sun and I genuinely think this is the best one on the market. It’s so good that it’s driven me to write this my very first AppStore review. 

The way it’s designed makes it motivating rather than punitive and all the copy/content/advice is evidence-based and written in a really lovely friendly voice. Independent developer too!
author: katiemary2000
